g.text: LEO SIGINT SATELLITE: MECHANICAL PACKAGING & SPACECRAFT ENVELOPE
ESPA-Class 24" Interface | Stowed Envelope: 600 x 600 x 800 mm | CBE: 121.50 kg | MEM: 146.73 kg (<= 150 kg Launch Limit)
EELV SECONDARY PAYLOAD ADAPTER (ESPA) MECHANICAL ELEVATION
AMMONIA HEAT PIPES (CCHP) & PCM BUFFER (1.2 kg)
LOWER BAY: PROPULSION & PRIMARY SHEAR RING
TOTAL STOWED ANTENNA VOLUME: 47.5 LITERS (< 50 L CEILING)
• Stowed Axial Natural Frequency : 68.5 Hz (Requirement: > 35 Hz) [PASS]
• Stowed Lateral Natural Frequency: 58.4 Hz (Requirement: > 20 Hz) [PASS]
• Deployed Antenna Mode Frequency : 2.15 Hz (Requirement: > 1.8 Hz) [PASS]
ADCS Separation Ratio: 43 : 1 (Precludes flexible body control spillover)
• Quasi-Static Design Load : 12.5 g Axial, 9.0 g Lateral
• Random Vibration Acoustic : 14.1 g_rms Qualification Envelope
Margin of Safety (Yield): MS_y = +0.45 | Ultimate: MS_u = +0.62
